# Lumen Books brand guidelines v1.0.0

A test fixture for cmo. Fictional brand.

## 0. Quick reference

- Name: Lumen Books, always two words.
- Colors: Lumen Yellow #FFD23F, Night #1B1B2F, Paper #FFFBF0.
- Type: Fraunces for headlines, Inter for text.

### The rules that matter most

1. Never claim same-day delivery: delivery is next day.
2. No superlatives, no exclamation marks in headlines.
3. Never put Lumen Yellow type on Paper.

## 1. Brand

### 1.1 Who we are and what we do
An independent bookshop with a reading club and next-day delivery in the city.
### 1.2 Brand name
Lumen Books. Never LB, never Lumen alone in headlines.
### 1.3 Audiences
See audiences.md.
### 1.4 Positioning and promise
Read something good, chosen by people who read.
### 1.5 Voice
Warm, plain, curious.
### 1.6 Registers (marketing and product, or others)
Marketing: short and warm. Product: what, when, how much.
### 1.7 Capitalization and punctuation
Sentence case. No exclamation marks in headlines.
### 1.8 Claims we can and cannot make
See claims.json.

## 2. Identity

### 2.1 Logo and files
assets/logo-black.svg, assets/logo-white.svg.
### 2.5 Placement
Bottom-left; bottom-right for Arabic.
### 2.7 Logo misuse (never)
Rotate, recolor, stretch, shadow, retype.

## 3. Typography

### 3.1 Typefaces
Fraunces 700, Inter 400.
### 3.4 Fixed ratios
Headline 2.5 times logo height; subhead half the headline.

## 4. Color

### 4.1 Core palette
Lumen Yellow, Night, Paper.
### 4.3 Allowed type and background pairs (with contrast)
Night on Lumen Yellow 11.7:1; Night on Paper 16.3:1; Paper on Night 16.3:1; Night on Sand (#F2EEE3) 14.6:1.
### 4.4 Forbidden pairs (never)
Lumen Yellow on Paper (1.4:1).
